The runner can checkpoint only segment-display text, so the DMD service-menu navigation is counted pulses; every diagnostic snapshot's interpreted_text is the curator's visual reading of its retained DMD frame, identified by its pixel SHA-256. The exact external directory manifest (built by tools/build_external_evidence_manifest.py) lists the raw trace, the copied scenario, the DMD frames and the isolated mutable state, with no ROM bytes.
